def transform(grid):
    """Fill the interiors of rectangular frames: odd interior width -> 7, even -> 2."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            top = min(y for y,x in cells); bottom = max(y for y,x in cells)
            left = min(x for y,x in cells); right = max(x for y,x in cells)
            if len(cells) != 2*((bottom-top+1)+(right-left+1))-4:
                continue
            if (len(cells) != (2*((bottom-top+1)+(right-left+1))-4)
                or not all(grid[top][x] == color and grid[bottom][x] == color for x in range(left,right+1))
                or not all(grid[y][left] == color and grid[y][right] == color for y in range(top,bottom+1))):
                continue
            fill = 7 if (right-left-1) % 2 else 2
            for y in range(top+1,bottom):
                for x in range(left+1,right):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
